resources.string: Skip video ads and sponsor parts
Mutes YouTube video ads, plays them fast and presses Skip as soon as it appears. Banner ads on the video are closed.
Jumps over sponsor parts in videos, from SponsorBlock\'s community list. Only a short code made from the video ID is sent to sponsor.ajay.app.
Also skips a sponsor part when you jump into it, tap one of its lines or replay a word there, so sponsor parts never play.
Ads still start, because YouTube decides when they play. If YouTube warns about ad blockers, turn Skip ads off.
